question: Does transparent case retrieval identify a transferable paired-content edit latent from one after-reference better than the failed continuous REPID13 student and fixed global operator?

primary_method_basis.paper: InstantRetouch: Personalized Image Retouching without Test-time Fine-tuning Using an Asymmetric Auto-Encoder
primary_method_basis.used_idea_only: fixed top-3 reference retrieval with temperature 0.1 over a frozen representation; no paper code, weights, architecture, dataset or thresholds beyond K and temperature are used
primary_method_basis.clean_room_difference: retrieval blends only bounded explicit operator parameters fitted from same-content pairs and never generates final RGB

retrieval.standardization: fit-only per-coordinate mean and standard deviation with 1e-8 floor
retrieval.similarity: cosine on standardized features with zero-norm rejection
retrieval.hard_medoid_control: K=1 observed paired-latent Euclidean medoid over all fit cases

stop_rules: Reuse the exact REPID13 roles, descriptor, paired-latent PCA and bounded operator without changing their values.
All calibration retrieval neighbors, weights and candidate/control parameters freeze before any calibration original is read.
The paired-latent top-3 oracle is computed only after prediction freeze and is diagnostic, never an input to the candidate.
Any calibration gate failure closes before sealed original or render acquisition.
No K, temperature, feature metric, medoid count, ridge, bounds, dose, role, threshold or gate rescue is allowed on this cohort.
A pass opens only a separately frozen sealed confirmation and does not prove latent modes or promote product behavior.
claim_ceiling: Private internal-research paired-supervised after-reference case routing to bounded explicit operators; not latent-mode, population preference, film, stock, scanner, arbitrary-source, package, capability or product evidence.
